title: lachnagrostis scabra
intro: Lachnagrostis scabra, commonly known as rough grass or saltbush grass, is a species of grass native to Australia. This plant has been traditionally used for its various health benefits, including its antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which can help to soothe wounds, reduce pain and swelling, and protect against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of Lachnagrostis scabra include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant effects. As a result, Lachnagrostis scabra has been used in traditional medicine for its therapeutic benefits, making it a valuable resource for promoting health and well-being.
